messages:
Alex: heads up — cluster autoscaler kicked a scaleDown in eu-west-1 (gpu-pool-2) at ~18:03 UTC and it's stuck because PDBs blocked eviction for 3 pods. scale-down pending.
Maria: saw that, eviction waits were >5m. any logs?
Alex: autoscaler-bot posted: `ScaleDownCandidate: node/gpu-node-07` then eviction failed with: `eviction API error: PodDisruptionBudget violated for selector app=training-job`
Jyoti: can we mark batch training pods as evictable via priorityClass or annotation? e.g. `priorityClassName: evictable-gpu` or `cluster.autoscaler.kubernetes.io/evictable=true`
Samir: we tried a priority class earlier but the job controller recreated pods immediately (no backoff). need a coordinated approach: CA flags + pod annotations + PDB fallback.
Maria: quick proposal for CA flags to reduce churn:
```
--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m
--scale-down-delay-after-add=12m
--scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.5
--max-empty-bulk-delete=1
```
and keep `--expendable-pods-priority-cutoff` tuned.
Alex: also consider adding a short drain kickoff delay (warmup) so long-running training pods get a chance to checkpoint before eviction.
Jyoti: another angle: label PDBs that are critical vs evictable, e.g. `pdb.redwood.io/evictable=false` and default controllers should only block when label says critical. then patch non-critical PDBs to `minAvailable: 0` as a fallback.
Samir: ops risk — if we make PDBs too lenient we could drop availability for a few tenants; need a canary and monitoring gating (cost/latency).
Alex: plan: 1) apply CA flag change to staging cluster, 2) add `evictable-gpu` priorityClass and doc in infra repo, 3) run a small patch job to mark batch-* PDBs as evictable in staging as a canary.
Maria: small utility to patch PDBs:
`kubectl patch pdb batch-training -n batch-foo -p '{"spec":{"minAvailable":0}}'`
Be careful with single quotes in automation.
Jyoti: also add SIGTERM handler to training jobs to checkpoint in <30s and set `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30`. that'll make drains cleaner.
autoscaler-bot: INFO: recent scaleDown attempt failed due to 3 matching PDBs. Next automatic attempt scheduled in 4m.
Samir: opened PR: infra/k8s/ca-tuning -> includes kustomize patch for flags, priorityClass manifest, and a job to label PDBs for canary. link: https://git.internal/repo/infra/ca-tuning (internal)
Alex: rolling CA flag change to staging now, will monitor `cluster-autoscaler` logs and `kube-events`. tagging @oncall-sre for observation.
oncall-sre: ack — watching eu-west-1 GPU dashboards and node pool health. will alert if pod restarts >2% or node pressure spikes.
Alex: follow-up: CA flags applied in staging; PDB patch job queued as canary for batch-staging. will report back in ~2h with results and cost/latency delta.
Maria: if canary looks good, we roll to prod with a 30m ramp and keep `max-empty-bulk-delete=1` to avoid mass evictions.
Jyoti: reminder: update runbooks (scale-down failures, PDB patch playbook) and include `kubectl` one-liners + how to revert PDBs.
Samir: noted — will add rollback steps in the PR.
Alex: resolution (interim): CA warmup delay increased to 12m in staging; canary PDB patches scheduled. next check-in in 2h.
